PM Modi Calls for More Female Representation at IIT Delhi

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the number of girls among medal winners at IIT Delhi "should have been more." He expressed this sentiment regarding the representation of female students receiving awards at the institution. The Prime Minister's remarks highlight a call for increased female participation and achievement in STEM fields.
